overview.intro1: The Z-boom KESLA 2112Z is in the 12 tonne-metre class. It comes with one or two extensions and in several outreach lengths. As part of the new KESLA 21-series, it has several features that make it easier to use and service, among them hoses and pipes inside both the lift and transfer booms.
overview.intro2: Like the other Z-cranes, its transport position saves load space. It works with 2-circuit or LS hydraulics and suits CTL and recycling work.
